the proposed SB-PERSB-PER mechanism with the LAUD policy is the best in most cases.

the proposed update-based cache access and replacement policies are superior to the access-based ones, and the proposed server-based PER is superior to the original client-based PER in terms of cost.
the proposed cache access and replacement mechanisms are more suitable for using both access information and update information than the existing access and replacement mechanisms.

update-based replacement policies are more suitable than access-based policies for cache replacement in wireless data access.
update information is important and should be taken into account in the cache replacement process in wireless networks.
